heldout_protocol: Four new papers, one per venue, selected for evaluation after development-set selection. Their text and briefs are excluded from writing-rule and percentile development. Existing model pretraining exposure cannot be excluded.
development_scope: 24 papers from the previously published exemplar corpus; all complete abstract/introduction passages targeted.
freeze_stage: Development IDs and annotation codebook fixed before annotation and held-out brief construction.
retrieval_and_statistics: Only development_ids are indexed by normal retrieval and empirical profiles.
